title: report.ingested event data
description: A report file attached to an existing execution. strength is structured only when the file matches that execution's intact manifest.

total.description: cases, alerts, (coverage) files, mutants, or metrics

report.description: k6: the summary's thresholds as counts and its metrics, labelled measured; Lighthouse: its metrics, labelled measured and never part of a status; both read from the stored (redacted) copy

anomalies.description: a measurement's flags, or load_limit_exceeded for a k6 summary past a limit of the execution's covering load-test grant; absent when none. load_limit_exceeded joins the execution's anomalies and turns its pass inconclusive

limitations.description: k6 only: each load limit the summary shows the run went past, as a run records it; absent when none
